I am 57 years old, I finished middle school, and I have farmed my land in Quzhou County for 25 years. My family has four people, and my son works in a factory in town, so we have some steady cash coming in. That gives me a bit of room to buy proper inputs, but I still watch every yuan because farming is what feeds us.

I have 14 mu. This year I am keeping the same layout as last year because it worked: 5 mu for stevia, which is my main money crop; 5 mu for wheat in winter then maize in summer, which is our foundation; and 4 mu for cotton. I do not like changing what works, and my neighbors who stick to steady rotations do better than the ones who gamble.

Right now it is spring. My wheat is already in the ground from last October. Before sowing I rotary tilled and put down 100 jin of compound fertilizer per mu — the 18-22-5 blend I buy from the dealer. Last month I topdressed with 50 jin of urea. In total that is about 30 kg of nitrogen, 12 kg of phosphorus, and 6 kg of potassium per mu. I already did the winter irrigation, and I will irrigate three more times before harvest in June. I will spray two more times for insects and disease, making four pesticide applications total. I planted an improved wheat variety using 30 jin of seed per mu, and I expect 1000 kg per mu.

For cotton on 4 mu, I am preparing the fields now. I will rotary till next week and lay plastic film. I use an improved cotton variety and sow about 2.5 jin of seed per mu. I put 100 jin of 15-15-15 compound as basal fertilizer, then topdress later with 100 jin of high-nitrogen compound. That comes to about 35 kg of nitrogen, 18 kg of phosphorus, and 18 kg of potassium per mu. Cotton is a spray-heavy crop — I will spray 12 times this year for bollworm, aphids, and weeds. I will irrigate three times. I expect 500 kg of seed cotton per mu.

For stevia on my 5 mu main crop, I will transplant seedlings in mid-April. I get improved seedlings from the agricultural station and plant about 8000 plants per mu. I rotary till first, then put 100 jin of 18-12-18 compound as basal. I topdress twice with 100 jin each of 15-15-15. Total nutrients are about 32 kg of nitrogen, 24 kg of phosphorus, and 28 kg of potassium per mu. Stevia needs water, so I will irrigate five times. I will spray 10 times total: seven for insects like cutworm and leafminer, two for leaf spot disease, and once for weeds. Last year I got 520 kg of dry leaves per mu; this year I am adding a bit more fertilizer and hope for 550 kg.

For summer maize on the same 5 mu as wheat: after harvest in early June, I will plant hybrid maize directly without tilling — no-tillage saves diesel and time. I use 1.2 bags of hybrid seed per mu. I put down 80 jin of 28-6-6 compound at planting, which is about 24 kg of nitrogen, 8 kg of phosphorus, and 8 kg of potassium per mu. I irrigate twice and spray three times. I expect 1200 kg per mu.

I set these amounts based on what I did last year and what my neighbors do. Old Zhang tried to save money on fertilizer and his yields dropped badly. I learned from that. With fertilizer, I would rather use a bit too much than risk losing yield. A bad harvest is a disaster; extra fertilizer is just a cost. My son's factory wage gives me room to buy proper inputs, so I do not cut corners.
